title: An n-dimensional linear subspace of ℝ^N is a C² Simon submanifold
statement: For every linear subspace P of ℝ^N with dim P = n (Module.finrank ℝ P = n), P is an n-dimensional C² submanifold in Simon's sense (Ch. 2, §4): Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := ℝ^n) 2 P. That is, 1 ≤ 2, and every point of P lies in an open set W carrying a one-to-one C² parametrization φ of W ∩ P from an open V ⊆ ℝ^n that is proper relative to (V, W) and has injective derivative everywhere.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Euclidean N)), Module.finrank ℝ P = n → Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Euclidean n) 2 (P : Set (Euclidean N))
